rule: Spec 049 §2.9: function v2 is prefix- + the first 32 lowercase hex of HMAC-SHA256(k_type, value) with k_type = HMAC-SHA256(FABRIC_WIRE_ID_KEY, 'fabric-id/v2/' + type); values and keys are UTF-8; without a key a v2 id is omitted (null). Provider ids use type 'provider' and prefix p-; the legacy unkeyed form p- + 16 hex of SHA-256 stays readable and the length tells them apart. Function v1 (r-, s-, svc-) is unchanged and pinned by contracts/capture/v1/fixtures/run-ids/run-id-pseudonym-v1.json, which this family re-verifies. key_id = 'kid-' + 8 hex of HMAC-SHA256(key, 'fabric-id/v2/kid'). Each 'distinct' pair must differ in its hex: v2 is domain-separated from v1 and between keys.

pending_types.reason: spec 049 §2.9 rule 2 names these prefixes but not the type strings that enter 'fabric-id/v2/' + type (only 'provider' is named); their vectors wait for the owner to fix the type strings
